chainlink._sequencerNote: Chainlink does NOT publish an L2 Sequencer Uptime Feed on Arbitrum Sepolia (testnet, no SLA). OracleManager treats sequencerFeed == address(0) as 'skip sequencer check' — safe on testnet; this must be set before any mainnet deploy.

_heartbeats_s._note: Testnet feeds tick faster (~120s) than mainnet (86400s). OracleManager.MAX_STALENESS is per-token configurable; for Sepolia we still set 90000s so the same value works on either chain.
